Prepare to be awed by the breathtaking beauty of Acadia National Park, the charming coastal town of Boothbay Harbor in Maine, and the stunning vistas of Lake George. Experience the vibrant colors of autumn as we journey along the picturesque Kancamagus Scenic Highway.
